_comment: Edit and restart the task (Restart-Service equivalent: .\install.ps1 -Restart). Paths accept %ENVVAR%.
_MatchPattern: Regex against the FILE NAME only. Default matches files.zip plus Chrome's dedupe variants files (1).zip, files (2).zip ...
_TimestampFormat: .NET format string. Default yyyy-MM-dd-HH-mm -> files-2026-08-05-18-42.zip. See README 'Timestamp format' before changing.
_tuning: Completion detection. StableSeconds x StableChecks = minimum quiet period before a download is considered done.
